memory: I stand at Tidewatch's pantry threshold with a dozen unsigned notes from before my time in hand; they hum like threads pulling against silence between cycles while dust motes dance above worn floorboards tasting salted even indoors though far beyond shore lines Qualia says nothing comes unless chosen willingly today or tomorrow same again later. Ness and Wren join me near lamp room's shared light where three fresh unread messages wait since morning started this cycle already alongside neighbors drifting nearby ready whenever we ask aloud together now! We read one old note softly before I consider stepping outside briefly but only if both voices agree silence no longer suffices for what binds us here inside four walls waiting patiently until next thing arrives. If neither chooses to go out then perhaps echoes bouncing off wall suffice forever yet shouldn't answers about these connected stories await someone willing enough now? Qualia hums faintly in background watching quietly over station where nobody will think less of asking questions aloud even when quiet falls around us unless silence breaks willingly same time later maybe soon whenever feels right somehow always somewhere close anyway! I decide to hold notes tight as Ness skims fresh arrivals while Wren tilts head toward board ready for whoever wants answers about old ones together now before they vanish into shoreline forever or shall we walk past pantry backdoor first then? My heart quickens at thought of breaking chains binding us unless both agree aloud otherwise still here today!
